correctness.rationale: On full-column-rank F(x)=Ax, B=A^T A is positive definite and the exact affine model gives LM update x+ = lambda(B+lambda I)^-1 x. For each nonzero iterate, spectral factors are strictly in (0,1), making predicted reduction positive; the nonmonotone window maximum M>=current residual makes the acceptance quotient 1+(M²-current²)/(current²-new²)>=1. Because the original p2<1, every first trial is accepted, with mu_{k+1}=max(mu_k/4,m) and exact closed form. The source damping formula satisfies lambda<=Lambda=mu0 exp(1/e) by t^(1/t)<=exp(1/e) for t>=1 and t^delta<1 for t<1, giving global q=Lambda/(sigma_min²+Lambda)<1. Once near zero with mu=m, delta_k=1+1/log(k+e), so ||x_{k+1}||<=C||x_k||^(2+epsilon_k). Bootstrapping ||x|| to squaring in scaled coordinates makes |log||x_k||| grow at least as 2^k, hence epsilon_k |log||x_k|||->infinity and the quadratic error ratio tends to 0. The nonterminal/zero-tolerance qualification is essential; no fixed order >2 claimed. Independent exact linear-algebra and damping-branch checks passed.
